data.query:
query Query($where: ProductStrategyWhereInput, $orderBy: [ProductStrategyOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  productStrategy(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        code
        weight
        active
        primary
        validated
        externalId
        name
        version
        effectiveAt
        expirationAt
        customData
        integrationData
        productId
        productStrategyStageId
        strategyTypeId
        consumptionUnitId
        inventoryUnitId
        purchaseUnitId
        saleUnitId
        unitTypeId
        weightUnitId
      }
    }
  }
}
